LanguageData.LP_RemoldingPool.label: necromantic remolding pool
LanguageData.LP_RemoldingPool.description: A 3×3 remolding pool. Modifies an existing necromantic construct's material investment, skill passions and knowledge specialty, keeping the individual, skill XP, relationships and implants. Takes 1 game day; command and upkeep continue; pauses if command is lost. Increasing investment pays the difference, decreasing refunds nothing, plus a 50 raw meat fee. Absorbs usable materials from anywhere on the map when entering; canceling after entering gives no refund. Deconstructing or destroying the pool releases the construct with its original configuration.
